clue.text: Wander around to escape pesky insect

parts.note: to gad is to wander around idly
to fly is to flee or escape

explanation.surface: Advice to dodge an annoying bug by wandering off.
explanation.definitionFit: A horsefly or cattle-biting fly that torments livestock is the classic pesky insect.

clue.text: Switch positions intermittently

explanation.surface: Toggling a switch now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: A switch's two positions are its settings, and the phrase also means occasionally, in fits and starts.

clue.text: One strips off, after rising in a dream?

indicators.note: after puts the reversed piece following the letter for one

parts.note: one is the article a

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: peels means strips off

explanation.surface: Someone undresses on getting out of bed in a dreamlike state.
explanation.definitionFit: Dreaming happens only while sleeping, so someone in a dream is slumbering.

clue.text: Boy snatching female underwear or dog

indicators.note: the boy grabs and holds the underwear inside himself

parts.note: a lad is a boy
a bra is a woman's undergarment
taken as written

explanation.surface: A lad grabs some lingerie, or perhaps the dog does.
explanation.definitionFit: A retriever breed from Canada, a common family pet.

clue.text: Finds Fiat car crashed round large road obstacle

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go round the letter for large
crashed suggests the words are smashed up and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A Fiat car crashes into something big in the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crashed' rearranges FINDS FIAT CAR into TRAFFICISAND, and 'round' puts L inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A raised area in the middle of a road that drivers must steer around is an obstacle.

clue.text: Film one patiently suffering in Rome

parts.note: someone in Rome is, for the clue's purpose, the Italian
Job is the biblical figure famous for enduring suffering with patience

explanation.surface: A patient sufferer endures life in Rome.
explanation.walkthrough: Job's patience is proverbial; placing him in Rome makes him the Italian one.
explanation.definitionFit: A 1969 British caper movie starring Michael Caine, with Minis racing through Turin.

clue.text: Trim feathers to inhibit brash display

definitions.text: Trim feathers to inhibit brash display

parts.words: Trim feathers to inhibit brash display
parts.note: pictures clipping a peacock's plumage so it can no longer show off, which is literally reducing a show-off's scale

explanation.surface: Clipping a peacock's tail to stop it strutting.
explanation.definitionFit: To humble a boastful person is to deflate their pride, just as clipping plumage shrinks a showy bird.

clue.text: New view of fine face, in old frame, offering nothing stimulating?

indicators.note: the word for old surrounds the rearranged letters like a picture frame

parts.note: dated means old-fashioned

indicators.note: a new view of the words means seeing their letters rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A fresh look at a pretty face in an old-fashioned picture frame proves dull.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New view of' rearranges FINE FACE into ECAFFEIN, and 'frame' sets it inside DATED, after its D.
explanation.definitionFit: Coffee with its caffeine removed provides no stimulant, hence offering nothing stimulating.

clue.text: Complaint about Labour PM reducing farmer's stock

parts.note: a beef is a grumble or complaint
c, for circa, means about

indicators.note: reducing means the name is shortened by losing its last letter

parts.note: Clement Attlee was the Labour prime minister of Britain from 1945 to 1951

explanation.surface: A grievance about a Labour prime minister cutting farm herds.
explanation.definitionFit: Cows raised for meat make up a farmer's livestock.

clue.text: King and I in German? That's priceless!

parts.note: R, for rex, is the abbreviation for king
ich is the German word for I

explanation.surface: The musical The King and I staged in German would be hilarious.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean wonderfully absurd or amusing, as in 'that's rich'.

clue.text: Stop roaming, avoiding river

indicators.note: avoiding means the river letter is left out

parts.note: stray means wander or roam
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: Advice to quit wandering and keep away from the river.
explanation.definitionFit: To remain in place is to halt and go no further.

clue.text: Went out, being left

explanation.surface: Someone left the house after being deposited somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Fell asleep is one sense of went out, and set down by a driver or delivered is the other.

clue.text: A measure of how difficult it is to understand geometry?

definitions.text: A measure of how difficult it is to understand geometry?

parts.words: A measure of how difficult it is to understand geometry?
parts.note: reads like a plot of the rate of mastering a skill, with a nod to geometry as the study of lines and bends

explanation.surface: Asking how hard geometry is to grasp.
explanation.definitionFit: A graph of progress against experience shows how hard a skill is to master, and a curve is also a geometric figure.

clue.text: Attractive? Entirely, and 19 -use the phone

parts.note: all means entirely
19 across is a university, abbreviated U
to ring is to telephone

explanation.surface: Something wholly appealing, with a university calling.
explanation.definitionFit: Tempting or enticing things draw you in, which is being attractive.

clue.text: Meet to study roadside

parts.note: to con is an old word for to study or learn
a verge is the grassy edge of a road

explanation.surface: Arranging to meet up by the road to read.
explanation.definitionFit: Lines or people coming together at one point are joining up.

clue.text: Apostle nob's represented here?

indicators.note: represented is read as re-presented, the letters set out afresh

parts.note: taken as written
the possessive s gives no letter, so only the word nob is used

explanation.surface: A grand apostle figure appears on a piece of cutlery.
explanation.walkthrough: Apostle spoons carry a figure of an apostle on the handle, so the whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Apostle spoons have a little saint, a holy head, on top of the handle.

clue.text: Elevated positions getting men in fuddled state

indicators.note: in a down clue elevated means the word goes upwards, so backwards

parts.note: puts means places or positions
OR, other ranks, means ordinary soldiers or men

explanation.surface: Men promoted to high posts end up confused.
explanation.definitionFit: A dazed, drowsy condition is a befuddled state.

clue.text: Religious figure, male, taking on Knight

parts.note: taken as written
K is the chess notation for king; here knight, as in the honour abbreviation

explanation.surface: A male religious figure taking on a knight.
explanation.definitionFit: A man in a monastic order living under vows is a devout figure.

clue.text: Accident is hard to locate in chart

indicators.note: in places the letters inside the chart word

parts.note: a map is a chart
taken as written
H is the pencil-grading abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: An accident spot is hard to find on the map.
explanation.definitionFit: A mishap is an unlucky accident or minor misfortune.

clue.text: Not locked? That's a shock

parts.note: a jar is a jolt or shock

explanation.surface: Finding the door open comes as a surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: A door left slightly open is unfastened, so certainly unsecured.

clue.text: United retreating in truth infiltrated by first of strikers from Academicals?

parts.note: U is the abbreviation for United in team names

indicators.note: retreating means the little word goes backwards

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the strikers' letter gets inside the word for truth

parts.note: verity means truth

indicators.note: first of picks the opening letter of strikers

explanation.surface: Football report: United falling back as strikers from Academicals break through.
explanation.walkthrough: Academicals are teams of academic clubs, so the question mark points to their institution.
explanation.definitionFit: Academicals is a name for teams and members of a seat of higher learning such as a college.

clue.text: National icon, as the white cliffs of Dover appear from the Channel?

definitions.text: National icon, as the white cliffs of Dover appear from the Channel?

parts.words: National icon, as the white cliffs of Dover appear from the Channel?
parts.note: the chalk cliffs are a shore of the country seen from the sea, and the institution is a national landmark too

explanation.surface: The white cliffs as seen by sailors crossing the Channel.
explanation.definitionFit: The central bank in Threadneedle Street is a national institution, and a bank is also a shore.
